Which statement explains the high melting point of potassium bromide?
A
There is strong covalent bonding between the molecules.
B
There is strong ionic bonding between the ions.
C
There are strong intermolecular forces between the molecules.
D
There are strong intermolecular forces between the ions.

options.label: A
options.text: There is strong covalent bonding between the molecules.

options.label: B
options.text: There is strong ionic bonding between the ions.

options.label: C
options.text: There are strong intermolecular forces between the molecules.

options.label: D
options.text: There are strong intermolecular forces between the ions.
